gaps.sentence: ___ honest answer would have saved everyone time.
___ water in this bottle tastes strange.
gaps.explanation: The of/in-phrase makes the noun definite: the water in this bottle.

gaps.sentence: They're building ___ new library near the town hall.
gaps.explanation: A new library — first mention; the town hall is the known one.

gaps.sentence: He demands ___ answer before the end of the day.

gaps.explanation: Plural general nouns and flu (illness name) take no article.

gaps.sentence: ___ Sahara is expanding southwards by several kilometres a year.
gaps.explanation: Desert names take 'the': the Sahara, the Kalahari.

gaps.sentence: The thief was sent to ___ prison for three years.
gaps.explanation: 'Sent to prison' — the institution, no article; 'the prison' would mean the building.

gaps.sentence: The car crashed into a wall at ___ speed of 90 km/h.
gaps.explanation: 'At a speed of…' — 'a' is part of this fixed phrase.
